description: Cancel a one-on-one session booking. Requires confirm set to CANCEL. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

bookingId.description: Session booking ID, from the session booking listing.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation for this write. Pass the exact literal this tool requires (for example DELETE) only after the user approves the action.

requestRefund.description: Whether to refund the booking when it is cancelled.

sessionId.description: One-to-one session product ID, from a Nas.com product listing.

transactionId.description: Transaction ID, from the transaction listing.

name: cancel_session_booking
title: Cancel Session Booking
